Frequently Asked Questions
Costs & Financial Aid
What kinds of scholarships are available for international students?
Visit International Students Scholarship Resources
Do I need to apply separately for financial aid?
Not necessarily. All admitted students will be evaluated for possible funding subject to funding availability.
When do you announce scholarship awards?
By early April.
How much is the tuition fee for graduate courses?
Please visit the tuition page to learn more.
Academics
Do you require GRE?
See the respective program pages for this information.
Can I switch from the thesis path to a no-thesis program?
Yes, but by the end of the 2nd semester.
Are the graduate degree programs in your department DHS STEM-Designated Degree Programs?
A: Yes. CS-CPI: 11.0701 AI-CPI:11.0102 DS-CPI: 30.7001
How can I switch between concentration and non-concentration degree programs?
Please fill out and submit this form.
Important Dates
When is the application deadline?
See the respective program pages for this information.
When is the assistantship application deadline?
January 31. See Applying for Financial Aid and GA.
When do the classes start?
Visit Calendars and Deadlines
How late can I arrive for Fall or Spring?
We do not recommend arriving more than a week after classes start. Please visit Calendars and Deadlines.
